claim: Donchian trend-following on BTC/ETH is profitable net of 25bps/side across the 50/100/200 lookback grid (Sharpe>0.7, maxDD<35%)
test: scripts/run_backtest.py on real Binance data 2017-present, walk-forward
result: FAIL as registered (2026-06-12, 3220 days). Sharpe by lookback: 50d=1.12, 100d=1.03, 200d=0.597 — gate failed only on the 200d leg. All returns positive (27%/25%/13% total), maxDD < 6%. Walk-forward: 3 of 4 two-year windows strongly positive (Sharpe 1.2-2.1); only 2021-23 negative (-1.6%, the bear/chop). Avg gross exposure 2.5% — the 0.5% per-trade risk cap against a 3xATR stop binds ~5x below the vol target, leaving capital idle.
decision: Retired as registered. No live capital under H1. Superseded by the explicitly post-hoc H1b with a stricter confirmation bar.

claim: POST-HOC (formed after seeing H1 results - confirmation bar is stricter for that reason): 50/100-day trend on an expanded liquid-major universe (BTC, ETH, BNB, XRP, SOL) passes the same gate, with sizing reconciled (per-trade risk 1.0%) so the vol target governs
test: scripts/run_backtest.py --config h1b (expanded universe is partial fresh evidence: BNB/XRP/SOL were not used to form the hypothesis). Then 4 clean paper weeks (scripts/cockpit.py --config h1b daily). Any live deployment starts at 10% of target size. Known caveat: universe chosen today = survivorship risk; mitigated by using only majors that passed liquidity screens for most of the sample.
result: GATE PASS (2026-06-12, real data, 3220 days, 5 majors): Sharpe 50d=1.257, 100d=1.097; total return 152%/122% (CAGR ~11%/9.5%); ann vol 8.6%; maxDD -14.6%/-14.3%; avg gross exposure 8.6%; turnover 3.4/2.7 per yr. Walk-forward: 3 of 4 windows positive (Sharpe 0.97-1.30), 2021-23 negative (-7.3%) as expected for the strategy class.
decision: Gate stage cleared. Post-hoc bar still applies: 4 clean paper weeks (cockpit.py --config h1b daily) before any capital, then live at 10% of target size. Survivorship caveat on universe stands.

claim: Funding carry above a 10% annualized hurdle is collectable net of 4-side costs
result: PASS (2026-06-12, BTCUSDT funding 2020-present): +7.3%/yr net on sleeve capital (10.1% gross), 45.6% time in market (~16%/yr while deployed), 18 round trips. Costs modeled at the pessimistic 25bps/side x 4 sides.
decision: Proceed to paper trading. Sleeve cap 30% of account, >=3x maintenance margin buffer. Currently OUT (funding below hurdle) - correct behavior, it waits.
